integrity: The proof is analytic over the two-element field. The included Python standard-library checker exhaustively tests 427 finite graphs (at most ten vertices); finite tests are not a proof for unbounded graphs. Earlier equivalent formulas remain a priority risk.
limitations: Classification is for finite undirected complete multipartite graphs, synchronous binary XOR updates without constant offsets, and period counts of global configurations. No extension to arbitrary graphs or real-valued perturbation growth is asserted.
title: Sharp period-four census for complete multipartite parity automata
